about.title: About
about.heroTitle: Shaoxing and Guangzhou mills, one accountable team.
about.heroDescription: We source woven and knit fabrics for brands and factories — lab dips, bulk production and export documentation managed as one program.
about.workflowDescription: Every program follows the same documented path — specs, lab dip approval, production QC and roll inspection before shipment.
about.closingTitle: Ready to specify your next program?
about.closingDescription: Share composition, GSM and colors — we reply with mill options and MOQ within 48 hours.

contact.heroDescription: Samples, MOQ questions or export programs — one contact from spec to shipment.

brands.title: For brands
brands.content: We support brand teams with swatch libraries, lab dips and bulk programs — composition and color standards locked before production.

retailers.title: For retailers
retailers.content: Retail teams receive size specs, fit samples and bulk programs with written QC gates before shipment.

agents.title: For agents
agents.description: Multi-brand sourcing with one documentation set.
agents.content: Agents consolidate styles across factories with shared inspection standards and export documentation.

size-specs.title: Size specifications
size-specs.content: We develop size charts and fit samples aligned to your target market — written approval before bulk cutting.

sampling.title: Sampling
sampling.description: Swatches, lab dips and development yardage.
sampling.content: Submit a spec sheet or reference swatch. We arrange hanger samples, lab dips and development yardage with written approval gates before bulk.

moq.title: MOQ & lead time
moq.content: MOQ varies by mill and construction — typical development yardage from 30m, bulk from 1,000m per color. Lead times confirmed in writing with your quote.

certifications.title: Certifications
certifications.description: OEKO-TEX, GOTS, BSCI and program-specific standards.
certifications.content: We match programs to mills with the certificates you require. Test reports and scope certificates are issued with your order file.

quality-control.title: Quality control
quality-control.content: Final inspection covers GSM, width, color delta, defects and roll length. Reports are signed before containers leave the mill.

how-it-works.title: How it works
how-it-works.content: Share specs → mill match → lab dip → bulk → inspect → ship. One team, one thread of communication.

faq.title: FAQ
faq.description: Common questions about sampling and MOQ.
faq.content: Lab dip cycles, MOQ ranges, payment terms and inspection standards — answered in writing before you commit to bulk.
